# ISSUE-02: Implement Interactive API Documentation (Swagger)

## Description
Provide a professional, interactive API portal using Swagger/OpenAPI. This will allow developers and stakeholders to explore and test endpoints directly from the browser.

## Tasks
- [ ] Install `swagger-jsdoc` and `swagger-ui-express`.
- [ ] Configure swagger definition in `src/server.js`.
- [ ] Add OpenAPI annotations to `auth.js` and `patients.js` routes.
- [ ] Verify documentation is accessible at `/api-docs`.
